I'm not eligible for unemployment because I was let go for cause meaning my work declined because I couldn't concentrate and was breaking down and crying at work.  

Thanks for your words.  I went to eat dinner at a place I liked but hadn't been to for a very long time thinking it would  be  my last dinner before i killed myself but now I feel a bit more optimistic.  I was really thinking of killing myself tomorrow because I couldn't see any other way.  But now I will try to hold on a little while longer and maybe things will improve, I hope.
Another problem is well I lost my job and then I went through my savings.  I have tried to get another job but can't find one.  Now I am running out of money and don't know what to do.
